quarters.title: Quarters
quarters.description: Calendar quarters to cover, e.g. ["2026-Q1"]. Empty = latest available quarter.

chambers.title: Chambers
chambers.description: Which chambers to scan for trades and committee membership.

overlap_types.title: Overlap types to include
overlap_types.description: committee_match = lobbying targeted a committee the member sits on. sector_match_only = sector overlap with no committee link.

max_concurrency.title: Max concurrency
max_concurrency.description: Bounded concurrency for outbound API calls (respect LDA rate limits). Clamped to 10 server-side regardless of the value entered here, to protect the shared LDA key's rate limit.

lda_api_key.title: Senate LDA API key
lda_api_key.description: Optional. The actor ships with a shared key sufficient for typical runs. Provide your own free key from lda.gov for heavy multi-quarter backfills or guaranteed throughput.

lda_max_pages.title: LDA max pages (debug)
lda_max_pages.description: Cap LDA result pages per quarter. Leave empty for full runs; set low (e.g. 5) for cheap test runs.

max_filings_per_record.title: Max lobbying filings per record
max_filings_per_record.description: Cap on the lobbying evidence list per overlap record (largest reported amounts kept). The record's lobbying_filing_count always shows the uncapped total.
